en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a large group of people marching in a parade or demonstration. The crowd consists of both men and women, some dressed in traditional clothing. Several people are carrying signs with Cyrillic script, and one person is holding a large flag. The background features early-to-mid 20th-century European-style buildings, with onlookers observing from windows and balconies.
